text:
maria: Heads-up — planning the welcome + launch drip for next week's benchmark webinar. Need segmentation, cadence, and quick wins. Quick sync?

josh: +1. My initial thought: two primary cohorts — 'trial-engaged' and 'new-signups'. Different subject lines, CTAs and frequency. I have draft copy.

anya: Love that. Add a third micro-cohort: 'opened-invite-not-registered' (watchlist) for a short retarget flow.

samir: Sequencing proposal: Day 0 invite -> Day 2 reminder -> Day 5 cutoff nudge. For trial-engaged, swap Day 5 for a technical follow-up highlighting cost/latency benchmarks.

lia: I can make two hero images + a 300x100 GIF for the trial-engaged variant. Need final CTA text and preferred color treatment.

josh: Draft subject lines (new-signups):
```
1) "See how inference costs dropped 3x — live benchmark"
2) "Benchmark results + webinar: save on LLM inference"
```
And UTM pattern: `utm_source=newsletter&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=benchmark_launch_3071`

maria: Can we A/B test subject lines and also 1-CTA vs 2-CTA layout? For APAC we should constrain send window to 09:00-11:00 local. Also prefer no heavy images for smaller cohorts. :eyes:

anya: A/B for new-signups makes sense. For trial-engaged, test 'Case study' vs 'Benchmark results' as the subject. Also recommend a short PS line for urgency on Day 2.

campaign-bot: campaign-scheduler: draft campaign created; id=cmp_2026_3071; status=draft; owner=maria

samir: Metrics to track: open rate, click-to-register (primary), registration-to-attendance, and post-webinar demo requests. Also track cost per registered lead by cohort. Can ops push events to the marketing dashboard?

maria: Yes — I'll own send ops and dashboard wiring. @lia please drop assets into #marketing-assets by EOD. @josh finalize copy variants and subject lines by 4pm so we can set up tests. Reconvene 11:30am tomorrow for final QA. :white_check_mark:

lia: On it — will upload 3 sizes (hero, banner, GIF) and a plain-text fallback. ETA 6pm.

josh: Will post the 4 subject lines + alt preview text in the thread by 3:45pm.

anya: I'll build the retarget audience and the watchlist rules in GA and send the segment IDs.

maria: Great — thanks team. Small ask: keep the welcome email under 120 words. We want scannable bullets and 1 clear CTA.

samir: Noted. Also recommend adding a short, one-question survey in the post-webinar email to improve funnel quality.

maria: Perfect. Meeting notes -> I'll paste final cadence + links in this thread after QA.
